_readme: Hand-curated events. status: 'confirmed' = organizer has announced the date; 'expected' = date estimated from the event's usual yearly pattern, not yet announced. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD (all day) or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (Denver local time). 'end' is inclusive for all-day events.

events.title: Tweed Ride Denver
events.location: RiNoVELO Bicycle Workshop, 3525 Walnut St, Denver
events.description: Dress in your best vintage tweed for a relaxed, fully supported ride through the city. Hosted by the RiNoVELO bike shop. All levels welcome; tickets on Eventbrite.

events.title: Winter Bike to Work Day
events.location: Statewide, with breakfast stations across metro Denver
events.description: The cold-weather edition of Bike to Work Day, held the second Friday of February. Register to find warm-up stations along your commute.

events.title: National Bike Month
events.description: The League of American Bicyclists' month of bike events every May. Colorado runs its own Bike Month in June.

events.title: Trail Ridge Road bikes-only spring riding
events.description: While plows clear Trail Ridge Road, cyclists may ride sections that are closed to cars, as long as the road isn't in winter trail status. How far you can go changes day to day. Call the road status line at 970-586-1222 before you go.

events.title: National Bike to School Day
events.description: Kids, parents and schools ride in together. Usually the first Wednesday in May.

events.title: National Bike to Work Day
events.description: The national date, the third Friday of May. Colorado's big statewide Bike to Work Day is in late June.

events.title: Trail Ridge Road opens to cars
events.description: The park aims to open Trail Ridge Road by Memorial Day weekend. Late snow has pushed the opening past Memorial Day six times since 1999. Once it opens, bikes share the road with traffic and must ride single file.

events.title: Mount Blue Sky Scenic Byway: 2027 status
events.description: The highest paved road in North America has been closed to cars for reconstruction through the 2026 season. The 2027 reopening, and whether the Mount Blue Sky Hill Climb returns, has not been announced. Placeholder date: Memorial Day weekend.

events.title: Colorado Bike Month
events.description: CDOT's statewide month of bike events, rides and commuter challenges, ending with Colorado Bike to Work Day.

events.title: Denver Bike Fest
events.location: York Street Yards, 3821 Steele St, Denver
events.description: Free community festival of bikes, music and food with 25+ local bike groups, shops and nonprofits, plus free bike valet. 2026 was Saturday, June 13 at York Street Yards.

events.title: Bike MS Colorado
events.description: Colorado's largest charity bike ride, a two-day fundraiser for the National MS Society. 2026 was June 13 and 14 from Greeley; earlier years started in Boulder in late June.

events.title: Colorado Bike to Work Day
events.location: Statewide, with hundreds of breakfast stations
events.description: One of the biggest bike-to-work days in the country. Held the last Wednesday of June. Free breakfast stations line the trails and bike lanes all morning.

events.title: Triple Bypass
events.description: Colorado's classic one-day mountain ride over Juniper, Loveland and Vail passes. 2026 was Saturday, July 11; 2027 is expected the same weekend.

events.title: Copper Triangle
events.description: The Ride Collective's loop over Fremont Pass, Tennessee Pass and Vail Pass. Usually the first Saturday of August (Aug 1, 2026).

events.title: Colorado's Ride (formerly Ride the Rockies)
events.description: Week-long supported tour through the mountains. 2026 ran Aug 9 to 14 through Buena Vista, Salida, Gunnison and Crested Butte. Organizers say the next route moves north.

events.title: Tour de Fat
events.description: New Belgium's costumed bike parade and festival. 2026 was Saturday, Aug 29.

events.title: Tour of the Moon
events.description: A car-free ride through Colorado National Monument's Rim Rock Drive, run by The Ride Collective. Capped at 2,200 riders and sells out every year. 2026 was Saturday, Sept 12.

events.title: Tour de Vineyards
events.description: A relaxed ride through Palisade's orchards and wineries, now 30 years running. Run by The Ride Collective. 2026 was Saturday, Sept 19.

events.title: Denver Century Ride
events.location: The Shops at Northfield, 8340 Northfield Blvd, Denver
events.description: Denver's flagship supported ride, with route options up to 100 miles. 2026 was Saturday, Sept 26; registration usually opens in December.

events.title: Trail Ridge Road closes to cars for the season
events.description: Trail Ridge usually closes for winter in mid to late October, whenever the first big storms arrive. After that it's bikes and feet only, where the road isn't snow-covered.

recurring.title: Denver Critical Mass
recurring.location: West High School, by Sunken Gardens Park, Denver
recurring.description: Leaderless monthly group ride and a demand for safer streets. Meet in front of West High School by Sunken Gardens Park. May to October: last Friday at 6:30pm. November to April: last Sunday at 12:30pm. Updates on Instagram @criticalmassdenver.

recurring.title: Lookout Mountain Full Moon Ride
recurring.location: The Pillars, base of Lookout Mountain Road, Beverly Heights, Golden
recurring.description: Night climb up Lookout Mountain under the full moon, with the road gated to cars. Meet at the Pillars at the bottom of Lookout Mountain Road around 9pm. Bring front and rear lights. Dates follow the full moon from May to October; the organizers confirm each ride in their Facebook group.

regular.title: Denver Critical Mass
regular.where: West High School, by Sunken Gardens Park
regular.blurb: Leaderless monthly ride for safer streets. Instagram: @criticalmassdenver.

regular.title: Denver Cruisers
regular.blurb: The original costumed party ride. Join their email list for each week’s meeting spot.

regular.title: Adventure Cycling shop ride
regular.blurb: Friendly, no-drop shop ride. Weather permitting.

regular.title: Mike's Bikes shop rides
regular.blurb: Casual guided rides and faster hill rides.

regular.title: Bike Streets free rides
regular.blurb: Easy pace on low-stress routes. Good first group ride.

regular.title: Denver Cycling Club · Phil's Circuit
regular.blurb: Social “B” pace road loop, all year.

regular.title: Denver Bicycle Touring Club
regular.blurb: Rated rides from flat to serious climbs, plus social “FUN Rides”.

regular.title: Team Evergreen
regular.when: Wed + Sun road, alt. Sat gravel
regular.blurb: One of Colorado’s biggest clubs. Their own site is down, so this links to the Triple Bypass, which they run.

regular.title: Women's Fun Biking Group
regular.blurb: Social rides, regular and e-bikes welcome.
